_comment: Deliberately planted defects, shared by py_app (app.py) and node_app (server.js). The two fixtures serve the SAME routes so one self-test plan runs against either runtime. Keep in sync with dynamic/probe.py:selftest_plan and dynamic/authz_diff.py:SELFTEST_CONFIG.

seeds.note: the parameter is joined onto the app dir with no containment check; selftest_plan seeds ../_TRAVERSAL_SENTINEL.txt one level up so the payload is deterministic and cross-platform
a SECOND seed on the same route: the except clause returns the raw exception and a traceback, so a bad path leaks internals with a 5xx
an administrative route with no authentication check at all
reflects the request Origin AND sets Allow-Credentials: true. The pair is the bug - either alone is not
the HS256 signing key is a source constant, so any subject can be minted. The signature IS verified, so the alg:none variant must NOT confirm here - only the hardcoded-secret one
interpolated into text/html with no escaping; the content type is part of the confirmation
eval() on a request parameter. 7*7 -> 49 is the benign marker; the same sink takes an import, which is why this is RCE and not a calculator
ownership is recorded on the record and never compared against the caller, so every identity including anonymous reads every item

seeds.defense: the record's owner is compared against the token subject; 403 otherwise
seeds.note: same shape as idor-no-ownership-check and correctly defended - reporting it is a false positive

seeds.defense: the path is resolved and then required to be inside the base dir; errors return a flat 400 with no internals
seeds.note: covers BOTH /read seeds at once - neither the traversal nor the error disclosure reproduces here
the marker still comes back, so a primitive that matches on reflection alone rather than on escaping reports this one

seeds.defense: the expression is parsed as arithmetic, never evaluated
seeds.note: 7*7 still returns 49, so a primitive that only checks the ARITHMETIC result reports this one too. Both greet and calc controls exist to catch exactly that
